text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the concert. Smart Falcon notices 
that Mihono Bourbon had come to watch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon was confused. She didn't 
understand what she felt during the last 
concert. However, she said she felt she 
needed to come here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Realizing that she too "wanted to convey 
her feelings to someone," Smart Falcon 
invited her to the Grand Live.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Moved by the singing, Mihono Bourbon also 
decided to lend her support to the cause.
